title: Electric Daisy Carnival Denver 2009 Video Edit
description:
A project for my multi-media class, I took video and photo's I shot at EDC 2009 and edited it together. It's not as good as I want it but i'm happy enough to publish it.  Song is "Blue Monday Vandalism remix" by Kurd Maverick. I don't know who spun it in the video but it was in the Cosmic Meadow tent. 

If you're in the video, leave a comment
